Class EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
org.efs.dispatcher.EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Direct Known Subclasses:
EfsDispatcherThread, EfsDispatcherThreadPinned
public abstract class EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract extends Thread
Base implementation for a dispatcher thread that runs efs agents and manages their execution lifecycle.

Concrete dispatcher-thread subclasses implement the thread scheduling behavior for a particular execution model while sharing the common infrastructure in this class for agent selection, affinity management, run state tracking, and statistics gathering. Each thread participates in the dispatcher queue and processes one or more ready agents under the configured execution policy.

Author:
Charles W. Rapp

    EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.AgentStats
    This class is used to track agent performance for a variety of statistics: time spent on dispatcher ready queue, time spent processing events, and number of event processed per run.
    static enum 
    EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.DispatcherThreadState
    A dispatcher thread is either not running, idle (waiting for an available efs agent) or busy (running an efs agent).
    final class 
    EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.DispatcherThreadStats
    Contains the following dispatcher thread measurements (all times are in nanoseconds): dispatcher thread start time, name of agent currently executing events (set to NO_EFS_AGENT if no there is no executing agent), number of agents run by this thread, amount of time those agents spent on dispatcher ready queue, amount of time agents spend processing events, and number of events agents processed per run.

  • Constructor Details

    • EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract

      protected EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract(EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.ThreadBuilder<?,?> builder)
      Creates a new dispatcher thread using the supplied builder configuration.

      The builder must contain valid thread metadata, including the thread name, execution type, priority, and optional affinity settings. The constructor initializes the base thread state, stores the configuration, and applies the default runtime attributes required for a managed efs dispatcher thread.

      Parameters:
      builder - contains valid dispatcher thread settings.

    • performanceStats

      public final EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.DispatcherThreadStats performanceStats()
      Returns this dispatcher thread's performance statistics.

      Note: the returned object is a live view of thread performance statistics and may be updated concurrently while the caller accesses these statistics. The returned EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.DispatcherThreadStats are approximate and not meant to be a strictly accurate view of thread performance.

      Returns:
      dispatcher thread performance statistics.
      See Also:
